goals.objective: Implement the fail-closed machine-readable assurance report contract.
acceptance_criteria: Mandatory gates cannot be averaged away.
Reports contain source and configuration provenance.

goals.objective: Prove the repository on every supported Node runtime and adjudicate production dependency findings.
acceptance_criteria: Every production advisory has a disposition.

goals.objective: Classify every registered HTTP route and MCP tool by executable coverage.
Prove MCP, proof, Council and OpenMythos truth invariants without external services.
Establish corpus maturity, provenance, repeatability and held-out discrimination.
acceptance_criteria: Corpus and oracle hashes are recorded.
Judge experiments are preregistered and repeatable.
Invalid evidence produces no aggregate claim.

goals.objective: Probe all required integrations read-only and verify effective identities.
acceptance_criteria: Every required integration has fresh evidence or a blocked reason.
Requested and effective models are compared.

goals.objective: Prove deployed source and database identity plus one bounded non-mock run.
acceptance_criteria: One bounded maker/checker proof has complete evidence.

goals.objective: Publish a reproducible assurance result without exceeding the evidence.
acceptance_criteria: All mandatory gates pass or the result remains blocked.
No external mutation occurred without approval.
